mapper.sql: emp00_person_id AS person_id , emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id , f_get_empTrans(emp00_person_id, emp00_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp00_kor_nm AS kor_name , ( SELECT i.org02_kor_nm FROM org02_info i WHERE i.org02_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND i.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(y.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info y WHERE y.org02_code_id = i.org02_code_id AND y.org02_mod_date <= emp00_trans_date ) ) AS org_kor_name , f_org_nm(emp00_org_code_id, f_today()) AS org_title_name
mapper.select: SELECT dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , dcr01_approval_type_cd AS approval_type_code , dcr01_seal_cd AS seal_code , dcr01_print_fund_yn AS print_fund_yn FROM dcr01_class_tree WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND dcr01_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT a.dcr05_title AS title , a.dcr05_content AS content FROM dcr05_doc_type a INNER JOIN dcr06_relate_doc_type b ON a.dcr05_doc_type_id = b.dcr06_doc_type_id WHERE dcr05_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr06_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND dcr06_default_yn = 'true' ORDER BY dcr05_title LIMIT 1
SELECT sys01_company_nm AS company_name , sys01_company_rep_nm AS company_rep_name , sys01_appr_step_lock_yn AS appr_step_lock_yn FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

WITH RECURSIVE org_list(org02_code_id, org02_parent_code_id, org02_kor_nm, org01_open_date, org01_close_date, org02_mod_date, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT b.org02_code_id, b.org02_parent_code_id, b.org02_kor_nm, a.org01_open_date, a.org01_close_date, b.org02_mod_date, 1, ARRAY[b.org02_kor_nm::text], false FROM org01_code a INNER JOIN org02_info b ON a.org01_code_id = b.org02_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{companyId} AND org01_code_id = #{orgId} AND f_to_number(org02_level_cd) >= CAST(#{approvalTypeCode} AS NUMERIC) AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN org01_open_date AND COALESCE(org01_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) UNION ALL SELECT b.org02_code_id, b.org02_parent_code_id, b.org02_kor_nm, a.org01_open_date, a.org01_close_date, b.org02_mod_date, c.depth + 1, array_append(c.path, b.org02_kor_nm::text), b.org02_kor_nm = ANY(c.path) FROM org01_code a, org02_info b, org_list c WHERE a.org01_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND c.org02_parent_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND f_to_number(org02_level_cd) >= CAST(#{approvalTypeCode} AS NUMERIC) AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN a.org01_open_date AND COALESCE(a.org01_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND b.org02_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = b.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= f_sysdate() ) AND NOT cycle ), SELECT t2.emp00_person_id AS person_id , t2.emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id FROM ( SELECT b.org01_code_id, c.org02_level_cd FROM org_list a INNER JOIN org01_code b ON a.org02_code_id = b.org01_code_id INNER JOIN org02_info c ON b.org01_code_id = c.org02_code_id ) t1 INNER JOIN emp00 t2 ON t2.emp00_org_code_id = t1.org01_code_id AND f_today() BETWEEN t2.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(t2.emp00_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND COALESCE(t2.emp00_org_head_yn, 'false') LIKE 'true' ORDER BY t1.org02_level_cd DESC, t2.emp00_pos_cd DESC, t2.emp00_emp_no
WITH SELECT FROM emp00 WHERE emp00_org_code_id = #{orgId} LIMIT 1

WITH SELECT FROM emp00 WHERE emp00_grade_cd = #{gradeCd} AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(emp00_close_date, to_date('99991231', 'yyyyMMdd')) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dcr01_class_tree WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
AND dcr01_comp_yn = 'true' AND dcr01_risk_yn = 'true' AND dcr01_mngm_yn = 'true' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp00_person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > f_today() OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date, '9999-12-31') < f_today() ) ) ORDER BY emp00_emp_no

WITH SELECT m.apr31_step_emp_id AS person_id , m.apr31_step_type_cd AS step_type_code , f_cdnm('AprStepTypeCode', m.apr31_step_type_cd, #{companyId}, f_today()) AS step_type_name , emp00_org_code_id AS org_code_id , f_get_empTrans(emp00_person_id, emp00_trans_date::date, 'title_nm') AS title_name , emp00_kor_nm AS kor_name , f_org_nm(emp00_org_code_id, f_today()) AS org_title_name FROM apr31_appr_step_group_member m INNER JOIN emp00 ON m.apr31_step_emp_id = emp00_person_id AND f_today() BETWEEN emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(emp00_close_date, TO_DATE('99991231','yyyyMMdd')) INNER JOIN dcr01_class_tree ON m.apr31_appr_step_group_id = dcr01_appr_step_group_id WHERE dcr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY m.apr31_seq

SELECT b.ics01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , b.ics01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , b.ics01_content AS content , b.ics01_submit_to AS submit_to , b.ics01_related_law AS related_law , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , c.sch03_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note FROM dcr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ics03_company_info ON ( ics03_company_id = dcr20_company_id AND ics03_ics_class_tree_id = dcr20_ics_class_tree_id ) LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_info_id = a.dcr20_ics_class_tree_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') AND c.sch03_company_id = b.ics01_company_id WHERE dcr20_dcr_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND COALESCE(ics03_except_yn,'false') != 'true'

SELECT b.icr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , b.icr01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name , f_icr_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.icr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , b.icr01_content AS content , b.icr01_submit_to AS submit_to , b.icr01_related_law AS related_law , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , c.sch03_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note FROM dcr21_relate_icr a INNER JOIN icr01_class_tree b ON a.dcr21_icr_class_tree_id = b.icr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_info_id = a.dcr21_icr_class_tree_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('6','7') AND c.sch03_company_id = b.icr01_company_id WHERE dcr21_dcr_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId} AND COALESCE(icr01_use_yn,'false') = 'true'
